snippet.title: Michael Jackson Memorial at His Childhood Home | 2300 Jackson Street, Gary Indiana #michaeljackson
snippet.description:
This short video shows the memorial plaque dedicated to the King of Pop, Michael Jackson, at his childhood home in Gary, Indiana.

The house at **2300 Jackson Street** is a modest 672-square-foot, two-bedroom bungalow built in 1949. Joe and Katherine Jackson bought it in 1950 and raised their nine children here, including Michael, Janet, and the Jackson 5. The family lived in this small home until 1969, when they moved to California after signing with Motown.

In front of the house stands this beautiful black granite memorial featuring Michael’s silhouette performing the moonwalk, his birth date (August 29, 1958), and passing date (June 25, 2009). It reads “Home Town of Michael Jackson – Gary, IN” and includes the touching line: “Never can say goodbye”.

Fans from around the world leave locks and messages on the fence as a tribute.

A powerful symbol of humble beginnings and legendary talent. ❤️

snippet.title: Jaafar Jackson Tours Michael Jackson's Home Studio at Hayvenhurst | Michael Movie BTS
snippet.description:
Jaafar Jackson inside Michael Jackson's personal home recording studio at Hayvenhurst Estate, Encino, California! This official Behind The Scenes clip from the 2026 Michael biopic movie shows Jaafar immersing himself in his uncle Michael Jackson’s creative sanctuary. 

The real Hayvenhurst home studio is where Michael recorded early demos for iconic albums including the Thriller era. Because the actual room was too small for filming, the production team meticulously recreated it on a soundstage, faithfully including the vintage reel-to-reel tape recorder, large mixing console, John Lennon inspirational quote on one wall, and Thomas Edison motivational quote on another — details confirmed from Michael’s real studio that inspired his dedication and practice.

Jaafar rehearsed and even slept at Hayvenhurst to deeply absorb Michael Jackson’s energy and legacy. A true temple of creativity and perfection! ❤️
